name: Free Couch on the Curb
text: A couch on the curb under a sign that says FREE. It has a stain shaped like a small country, and something inside it just moved. You have slept on worse. You are about to prove it.

dumb.label: Take a nap on it
dumb.text: Full heal; 30% chance to add Bedbugs, a junk card that deals 1 damage when drawn.
